candidate_sentences.text: For the second quarter of 2026, the bank generated a pre-tax profit of ISK 1,545 million, representing a decrease of 23.7% compared with ISK 2,025 million in the second quarter of 2025.
Net interest income demonstrated resilience, rising by 1.7% year-on-year to ISK 3,013 million, supported by ongoing lending momentum.

Net fee and commission income remained subdued at ISK 1,416 million, representing a 26.8% decrease from ISK 1,935 million in the second quarter of 2025, reflecting continued soft activity in capital markets and lower transaction volumes.

Administrative expenses for the second quarter of 2026 were ISK 2,947 million, reflecting a 1.1% decrease year-on-year despite the inclusion of a one-off restructuring charge of ISK 112 million incurred in June to implement efficiency measures.
The bank expects these measures to lower the annual cost base going forward.
